risks.proof: A wide shot showing the full assembly.

risks.risk: Missing essential components like the bobbin case or shuttle
risks.proof: A photo of the underside/shuttle area.

proof_requests: Video of the machine sewing a line of stitches.
Photos of the stand, table, or carrying case if included.
Photo of the underside showing the bobbin and shuttle mechanism.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Butterfly brand sewing machine head. It can be priced at the worst-case value for a non-working head only, as no stand is shown and operation is not proven.
